title: Slowing Growth in Steel Output Ex-China
section_path: Slowing Growth in Steel Output Ex-China
section_path_text: Slowing Growth in Steel Output Ex-China
summary:
Main
By Jeffrey Landsberg
As we discussed in Commodore Research's most recent Weekly Executive Report, global steel production totaled approximately 142.4 million tons in September. This is down month-on-month by 1.8 million tons (-1%) and but up year-on-year by 600,000 tons. Steel production ex-China totaled approximately 68.8 million tons.
